Messages.Author: Jack Crow
Messages.Body:
If you play Shadow Twin, Superior, at a retainer, does the card attach and
affect the minion it is attached to?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From ja...@nowhere.com (Jack Crow) =====

>If you play Shadow Twin, Superior, at a retainer, does the card attach and
>affect the minion it is attached to?

No. Retainers are not minions and ST gives no accomodation for moving it
to the employer of the retainer.
